name: YMCA Leaders Club (Middle and High School)
city: Chapel Hill and the Triangle, NC
what_you_do: A year-long leadership and community service club for teens that meets at local YMCA branches. Members get leadership training and volunteer with Y programs.
grades: 6-12 (Middle School Leaders Club grades 6-8; High School Leaders Club grades 9-12)
who_can_apply: Middle and high school students. Chapel Hill-Carrboro YMCA also requires a nomination form, an application and a handbook review. The page does not say which listed branches are in Raleigh or Durham.
pay_detail: 2026-27 dues: $240 per year (Member) or $301 per year (Participant); club dues only, not annual events
duration: Early fall to the end of the school year
deadline_text: No registration deadline stated. Clubs start in early fall; A.E. Finley YMCA held interest meetings September 15 and 16, 2026.
how_to_apply: Register online through the link on the page, attend an interest meeting, or contact your branch's Teen Director.
notes: Branches listed: A.E. Finley, Alexander Family, Chapel Hill-Carrboro, East Triangle, Kerr Family, Kraft Family, Northwest Cary, Poole Family and Taylor Family YMCAs. The page does not explain the difference between Member and Participant dues.
